newsitem.title: USA: ADT Ltd unit prices tender for notes.
newsitem.headline: ADT Ltd unit prices tender for notes.

text.p: ADT Ltd said Friday that its ADT Operations Inc subsidiary had priced its tender offers to buy for cash outstanding 8-1/4 percent Senior Notes due 2000 and outstanding 9-1/4 percent Senior Subordinated Notes due 2003.
It said the price for the 8-1/4 percent notes will be $1,050.30 per $1,000 principal amount, and the price for the 9-1/4 percent notes will be $1,068.84 per $1,000 principal amount.
It said the assumed date of payment is July 8 and that the offers are scheduled to expire July 2, unless extended or terminated.
J.P. Morgan Securities Inc is acting as dealer manager in connection with the tender offers and will provide certain financial advisory services to ADT Operations Inc.
